Container.Name: Dockit
Container.Overview: Pin your URLs. One page for the tools the team actually opens. Self-hosted, one JSON file, no database.
Container.Description:
Dockit is a shared home page for the web tools and apps a team actually uses, organised by space, category and card.
The portal lives in one file on the appdata share. Backup = copy that folder.
HTTP link probes work with no extra privileges. ICMP (ping) needs Extra Parameters: --cap-add=NET_RAW. On a locked-down Unraid / remote host you can leave that off.
SSO client secret and LDAP bind password: paste them in Dockit Settings, or set the optional environment variables below (fields in Settings then stay empty). Local login always remains.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: portal urls bookmarks intranet dashboard homelab
Container.Requires: A strong PORTAL_EDIT_PASSWORD (12 characters or more).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: portal.json, curation and uploaded assets. Backup this folder.

Config.Name: Edit password
Config.Description: Required. 12 characters or more. First login is this password for user admin (or Edit user below).

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Public URL if behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://portal.example. Leave empty on the LAN.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 when behind a reverse proxy so Dockit honours X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the SSO secret is not stored in portal.json. Otherwise paste it in Dockit Settings.

Config.Name: LDAP bind password
Config.Description: Optional. One bind password for every directory. Different accounts: leave this empty and use PORTAL_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD_<ID>, or paste in Settings.
